content.document_title: Clinical Practice Guidelines Committee 2022-2024 - Declarations of Interest (page 11/12)
content.notes: Report lists declarations of interest as reported to the ESC by the experts during the yearly call for declaration covering previous calendar year. Calls for declaration conducted during development period of these guidelines up to and including 2023.

entries.declaration: Ongoing research funding from public and/or not-for-profit organisations (started or continuing in 2023): Cancer UK. Payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member, including travel funding. Companies listed: Aboca, SRL. Other editorial and associate editor roles across multiple journals (Diabetes and Vascular Disease Research Advisory Board; Cardiovascular Drugs and Therapy; Clinical Pharmacology; Frontiers in Drug Safety and Regulation; European Cardiology Review; European Journal of Preventive Cardiology; Journal of Thrombosis and Thrombolysis; International Journal of Cardiology).

Direct personal payment from healthcare industry: speaker fees, honoraria, consultancy, advisory board fees, investigator, committee member. Companies/devices listed: Boston Scientific (coronary stents, IVUS, Accurate aortic valves (TAVI), Watchman (LAAO)); Medtronic (Evolute aortic valves (TAVI)); Edwards Lifesciences (Sapien aortic valves (TAVI)).
